text.tspan: MainActivity renders one of three auth states before the NavHost exists: Loading → Setup (no accounts) / Sign in / Home (remembered user). Sign out (Account menu or Settings) returns to Sign in; a different user gets a fresh navigation stack (key(user.id)). Passwords are PBKDF2-hashed on the phone; 5 wrong attempts lock sign-in for 30 s.

text.tspan: Return after save / photo (popBackStack to the opener)
← / system Back → previous screen on the stack
Opens a pop-up / menu / permission prompt
Hands off to Android / another app / server
✓ in an arrow label, or '✓ RUN' on a screen = exercised in the Android 16 emulator walkthrough; everything else is traced in source.
ADMIN dashed outline inside a frame = control rendered only when user.isAdmin. Dashed tray under a frame = that screen's pop-ups and hand-offs.
Every screen with ← (and the system Back gesture) returns to the previous screen via NavController.popBackStack(); only non-obvious returns are drawn.
Hover a frame or arrow in the .drawio/.svg to see its route, source file:line, roles and verification status.
